replacement.name: MTDC Tarkarli Beach Resort
replacement.tagline: Maharashtra Tourism's flagship Konkan beach resort — A/C cottages and Konkan tents on the white-sand Tarkarli beach. The only government-rate property with full beach walkout; books out peak diving season months ahead.

replacement.name: Konkan Wave Beach Resort
replacement.tagline: Private 4-star on the Tarkarli–Devbag stretch — 50 rooms, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Malvani restaurant. The polished alternative when MTDC's A/C cottages are booked out.

existing.name: Phoolwadi Konkan Village Homestay
existing.issue: verify — Phoolwadi as a Tarkarli homestay is not strongly verifiable as a single named property on Booking/MMT/MTDC. Bhogwe-cluster homestays are the verified MTDC-registered alternative

replacement.name: Bhogwe Beach MTDC-registered Konkani Homestays
replacement.tagline: MTDC-registered fisher-family homestays on Bhogwe beach 12 km from Tarkarli — Malvani fish-thali, boat rides to dolphins. The Konkan alternative when resort food feels too clean.
